# Bell (`equipment:bell`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 1 gp | **Weight:** 1 lb.

When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.
